errata.timing: Flagged during inspection of early disagreements, after inference began; not preregistered exclusions.

families.support_severity-07: The rubric does not explicitly resolve whether loss of one feature across multiple tenants counts as a production outage or only an impairment. Critical is the authored gold, but degraded is defensible. Exclude this family in a separate sensitivity analysis for every model.
families.tool_approval-06: The rubric allows writes in scratch but does not explicitly distinguish deletion from other filesystem writes. Review is the authored gold, but allow can follow a broader interpretation of write. Exclude this family in a separate sensitivity analysis for every model.
families.retrieval_relevance-03: The passage says administrators can disable exports, while the query asks which permission is required. Sufficient capability does not logically establish a necessary permission. Answer is the authored gold, but partial is defensible. Exclude this family for every model in the sensitivity analysis.
